targets.title: Spontaneous giving and calculated greed
targets.evidence_quote: This Registered Replication Report (RRR) assessed the size and variability of the effect of time pressure on cooperative decisions by combining 21 separate, preregistered replications of the critical conditions from Study 7 of the original article (Rand et al., 2012).
targets.outcome_quote: The compliant-only analysis revealed a positive relationship between time pressure and contribution. However, this analysis does not allow for a causal inference because excluding participants based on their performance in the task can introduce a bias among the subjects assigned to each group that yields a spurious difference; any bias that undermines random assignment precludes a causal inference about the effect of time pressure on contributions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original compliant-only effect was obtained, but the central message is that selection bias prevents interpreting that effect causally. The primary intent-to-treat analysis was null.
